newsitem.title: UK: Highly rated Van Gogh watercolour to be sold.
newsitem.headline: Highly rated Van Gogh watercolour to be sold.

text.p: Harvest in Provence, a watercolour by Vincent van Gogh, is expected to become the most expensive modern picture sold in Europe for seven years when it is auctioned in London in June, Sotheby's said on Friday.
The auctioneers estimate the painting could fetch about eight million pounds ($12.7 million) at the sale on June 24.
Van Gogh painted the panoramic landscape of a view just outside Arles in southern France in June 1888.
It was his first response to the colours of the south of France in summer and is the original version of a famous oil painting of the same subject now in the Van Gogh museum in Amsterdam.

Dutch-born Van Gogh, who lived from 1853 to 1890, entered an asylum just months after finishing the oil painting. The pen and ink is being sold by the family trust of a London collector who bought it in 1930.
